collections/heap#

An immutable persistent min-heap.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let empty is List<int> = EmptyList();
let heap = Heap(values: empty.prefix(7).prefix(2).prefix(5));
heap.top();                    // 2
heap.remainder().top();        // 5

Description#

An immutable persistent min-heap.

Construct a heap from any Iterating value. top() returns the least value according to Comparing<T>, and remainder() removes one occurrence of it:

addition() and remainder() return new heaps. They never change their receiver, so earlier versions remain valid and share immutable tree nodes:

let original = Heap(values: empty).addition(3);
let extended = original.addition(1);
original.top();                // still 3
extended.top();                // 1

Heap deliberately exposes no cursor and no heap-array representation. A heap guarantees access to the least value, not a traversal order. Repeated top()/remainder() calls consume values in ascending order.

The representation is a persistent leftist tree. size() and top() are O(1); addition() and remainder() are O(log n). top() and remainder() on an empty heap throw EmptySequence.
